title: Fabric_4L Control Plane — Behavior Card Frontmatter
description: JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the YAML frontmatter embedded at the top of every behavior card under control-plane/behaviors/ (e.g. BEH-01-account-intake.md). The frontmatter is extracted and validated against this schema in CI.

rule_id.description: Normative product rule ID, e.g. R-1

story_id.description: User story / value proposition ID, e.g. VP-05

journey_id.description: Canonical journey stage ID, e.g. J-2

gate_id.description: Aggregate release gate ID, e.g. AG-04

control_id.description: Individual release control ID, e.g. CTRL-04-02

id.description: Card ID; must match the filename prefix (BEH-xx-...) and the manifest entry.

journey_stage.description: Primary canonical journey stage this behavior belongs to.

rules.description: Normative product rules (R-x) governing this behavior.

boundary.description: Architecture layer boundary, e.g. 'L4 -> L5 -> L3'

primary_gates.description: Aggregate release gates (AG-xx) that must pass for this behavior to ship.

controls.description: Individual release controls (CTRL-xx-nn) proven by this behavior's verification section.

evidence.description: Evidence types (EV-x) this behavior must produce.
